definitions.shipment_information: Shipment Visibility. 'Where is my shipment?' — current location / visibility state of a load.
definitions.realtime_query: Shipment questions about ETAs, statuses, and reference numbers for specific loads (live lookups).
definitions.analytics: Aggregated answers from reasoning over historic data (counts, trends, breakdowns).
definitions.disruptions: Questions about disruptions affecting shipments or the supply chain (weather, ports, borders, capacity).
definitions.chitchat: Generic conversation with the bot ('hi', 'how are you', 'what can you do').
definitions.knowledge_base: Questions to understand a product or a feature ('how do I add a user').
definitions.other: Out of FourKites' scope, or fits none of the classes above.

note: Closed set of 7 labels. Classes are imbalanced; the scorer weights macro-F1 at 0.6 so rare classes count. Test distribution is withheld.
